extracted.name: Tzatziki Sauce — Yogurt and Cucumber Dip
extracted.description: This tzatziki sauce — yogurt and cucumber dip recipe starts with drained yogurt and grated cucumbers mixed with minced garlic, dill, and lemon juice.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Line a colander with two layers of cheesecloth; place over a bowl. Place yogurt in cheesecloth-lined colander; cover with plastic wrap. Drain yogurt 8 hours to overnight.
Place grated cucumber in a fine-mesh strainer; drain 1 to 2 hours.
Combine yogurt, cucumber, dill, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; refrigerate for flavors to meld, at least 2 hours.
